lines.text: In 2006, scientists trapped a few crows for a study.

parts.tts: In two thousand six, scientists trapped a few crows for a study.
parts.heard: In 2006, scientists trapped a few crows for a study.

lines.text: One of them wore a caveman mask. Big mistake.

parts.tts: One of them wore a caveman mask. Big mistake.
parts.heard: One of them wore a caveman mask. Big mistake.

lines.text: For the next 17 years, anyone in that mask got screamed at and dive-bombed on sight.

parts.tts: For the next seventeen years, anyone in that mask got screamed at and dive-bombed on sight.
parts.heard: For the next 17 years, anyone in that mask got screamed at and dive-bombed on-site.

lines.text: It gets worse. Crows that were never trapped joined in. They learned the hate by watching.

parts.tts: It gets worse. Crows that were never trapped joined in. They learned the hate by watching.
parts.heard: It gets worse. Crows that were never trapped joined in. They learned the hate by watching.

lines.text: Then they taught it to their babies. A generational grudge.

parts.tts: Then they taught it to their babies. A generational grudge.
parts.heard: Then they taught it to their babies, a generational grudge.

lines.text: The scientists tested a second mask to compare. They picked Dick Cheney.

parts.tts: The scientists tested a second mask to compare. They picked Dick Cheney.
parts.heard: The scientists tested a second mask to compare. They picked Dick Cheney.

lines.text: The crows were completely fine with Dick Cheney.

parts.tts: The crows were completely fine with Dick Cheney.
parts.heard: The crows were completely fine with Dick Cheney.

lines.text: The feud only ended in 2023, after the last crow from 2006 died.

parts.tts: The feud only ended in twenty twenty-three, after the last crow from two thousand six died.
parts.heard: The feud only ended in 2023, after the last Crow from 2006 died.

lines.text: So if a crow is staring at you right now... what did you do in 2006?

parts.tts: So if a crow is staring at you right now...
